title: 🔁 SPN-156 Sync saved edits while the file list is open
body:
Saved offline edits previously waited for their editor to reopen after the running file list reconnected. This adds one account-scoped replay owner for eligible downloaded Docs and Sheets, using the existing native sync client, authority checks and durable checkpoint path. Foreground editing or explicit device maintenance reserves priority and joins replay teardown before taking the actual item writer, including across tabs.

🚧 **Draft validation candidate; complete acceptance remains pending.** Exact candidate source `5c764793f03f7f885873d08d6eca0660cd401bf0`, base `c525aa933505d6e78b8fdd7a89940d87506d5cb3`, tree `d50abe8337f5855246e06511a5faf9e8bda7a138`. Actual SPN-157/full-groom main is integrated. Both independent exact-head revalidations are complete; the manager has verified the source and both exact-head PR receipts. Hosted publication is next; the draft remains unmergeable while acceptance is incomplete. No repaired-head hosted build/tested merge exists yet. Provisional ticket removal is not completion or merge permission.

## 🧭 Complete scope and decisions

The full **L, pre-launch** outcome retains editor-independent Doc/Sheet replay, exact account/item authority and revocation, exclusive writer ownership, persisted snapshot/outbox acknowledgement, exactly-once retry, interruption/recovery, separate-viewer content and a bounded installed-phone observation. Closed-app OS background execution, periodic polling, unrelated offline image/creation changes and iPhone acceptance remain outside this ticket.

[Original ticket](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/c525aa933505d6e78b8fdd7a89940d87506d5cb3/docs/todo/SPN-156.md), [canonical decisions and complete evidence](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/5c764793f03f7f885873d08d6eca0660cd401bf0/docs/implementation/SPN-156.md), [complete base/source diff](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/compare/c525aa933505d6e78b8fdd7a89940d87506d5cb3...5c764793f03f7f885873d08d6eca0660cd401bf0).

All four personas informed the design. Owner gets durable delivery and foreground priority; Collaborator retains the existing account/access/revocation path and recoverable work; Operator gets bounded native concurrency and inspectable cleanup using existing components; Link guest receives no private replay owner or account store. Lost-ack attention remains conservative. Background replay cannot silently publish a recovery copy. This connects existing pending/saved/attention states; no new visual component, layout/theme change or routine screenshot matrix is introduced. Actual rendering and native interaction checks remain required. **Agent review only.**

## 🛠️ Repairs and retained first hosted failures

The original `40dee0d32cd3cce4bd9c1cbea74aeccdd1d83b47` validation remains failed. [Published original terminal archive](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/archive/spn-156-validation-40dee0d3-20261114/docs/review-assets/spn-156-validation-40dee0d3), immutable commit `3b496299a9f91ca797c5d80683aaede15660842a`, preserves source/base/tested-tree binding, all configured attempts and raw diagnostics. Original tested merge `eaaf75f393ab91d9fd1120cbff63c034b481bada` and application share tree `e5a4a18403609e80332137266365993a32abc93e`.

- **Cross-tab explicit discard exposed a product gap.** Original production-2 job `132380984914`, CI run `43572864010` attempt 1, retained authored 556/revision 1 with no submissions in both tabs, yet final discard met a nonexistent-editor busy refusal. Replay in the other tab held the real writer; the original same-tab stop map could not reach it. The repair adds a bounded shared replay admission gate and queued exclusive foreground priority using Web Locks and scoped storage events. Foreground queues before notifying, avoiding deadlock and replay reacquisition races, then joins quiet/persist/dispose. Live editors retain immediate nonblocking refusal. Wrong scope, stale requests, denied/missing transport, cancellation, timeout and cleanup failures remain fail-closed.
- **Quota and original-account recovery fixtures allowed legitimate replay before expecting pending state.** Every original attempt has a matching nonduplicate server acknowledgement and exact durable content: Sheet 552 or Doc “Kept through account exit 5581”, revision 2, empty pending buffer. This was not evidence of lost edits or partial quota transaction mutation. The fixtures now prove authored durable buffers and hold real native resume while HTTP/image access remains available; zero-submit/unchanged-server and original transaction, image, warning, account-isolation and offline-reopen assertions remain. The cross-tab discard fixture separately establishes a held real replay gate and pending content before explicit discard. All **nine failed attempts** remain retained. Production-2 artifact `14106362554`, ZIP SHA-256 `0c6bf77a4c817a1d2dc5843f7cd8b2a172947bdcc29f011fcd6cad4c643da8c8`, includes the reporter, screenshots, diagnostics and configured retry-1 traces. Frame arrays have no per-frame timestamp and failure cleanup did not retain a final server-database snapshot; neither is invented.
- **Native Desktop Chrome click was obstructed.** Run `43572863994` attempt 1, Chrome/macOS26 job `132380800458`, artifact `14105073087`, ZIP SHA-256 `c7887b140a624c9387eae654ca1a376cf0beee1e031739eeeba379acacf3b479`. Normal Sheet/Doc replay and conflict-Sheet checks completed before the protected-content warning covered the conflict Doc's Save details control. Browser 5058/driver 5054 exited; later conflict-Doc/storage-loss assertions were not completed. Safari/Firefox passed independently. Repair `def39e338f9aab57e11a940aa1622b5015f1f930` waits for the named control to be enabled, intersect the viewport and own its clipped center hit, then posts the same one native click under the unchanged 45-second deadline. No forced input, toast hiding, input retry or warning-cause repair is claimed.
- **Independent review found a denied-storage wrapper leak.** Epoch capture could throw after temporary-writer registration but before cleanup. Repair `16f4bb3bc9b850b3d51fdbbbd0e29f2ace459ca8` captures the fence before registration, retaining original refusal/no operation. Its actual-wrapper regression restores storage and requires replay reservation, actual editor lock admission, subsequent maintenance and empty final ownership. Exact original source fails directly at the reservation invariant before a blocked wait. Both original findings and the first actual-module failure remain preserved; historical numerical reports were moved outside blinded reviewer inputs without destroying their bytes.

Original successes are also retained with their original identity: sync-production job `132380984871` passed both new cases once on retry 0 (Doc+Sheet 10,042 ms; revoked edits 3,009 ms), within 100 passing cases. Artifact `14106192016`, ZIP SHA-256 `98133cc68ec42dc8b00258a21feda8e8e4d77f3bc2eb39c96bf66d0e0adc5830`, binds actual content/revisions, durable acknowledgement, second-viewer checks and file-list-only originating page; revoked work remained pending without submission/recovery-copy creation. Original Lib-remaining job `132380984700` ran the two actual native checkpoint cases successfully (137 ms), within 969 passed/3 skipped. Six original required gates passed; Playwright aggregate failed. These are **40de outcomes**, not current repaired-head acceptance.

title: 🖼️ SPN-068 Insert images into a Sheet
body:
## Why

Sheets could display stored images but account editors could not add their own. This change makes the native **Insert → Image → Float Image / Cell Image** flow usable, including external image-file paste and drop, while preserving saved bytes, collaboration and native editing.

**Reviewed head:** `eb72be12e3ef774bd8f5938010f193db5b289516`  
**Base:** `e63956c7ec214af03c825104a81f63517eb87d0b`  
The requested outcome is an open, mergeable PR; leave it unmerged.

## What changes

- Reuse the existing item-scoped PNG/JPEG/WebP upload route and its decoding, sanitization, deduplication and limits: **5 MiB/file, 16 megapixels, 50 MiB retained/document**.
- Await the entire native insertion, including image decoding and its drawing/cell mutation. Saving, navigation and refresh protection remain active until it settles; closing the editor cancels outstanding work.
- Capture the target before the chooser opens and recheck selection, cell content, worksheet structure and current edit authority before a late insertion. Refuse a changed target or lost access with a useful retry message.
- Preserve native Undo/Redo, movement, cut/paste, worksheet duplication, live peer delivery, reload and named history. A small public render interceptor copies cell-image layout input because Univer's nested display mutation otherwise changed authored content, triggered a sync divergence and discarded Undo.
- Allow new uploads for account editors only, preserving ordinary-item and exact Space-child access. Existing Doc guest uploads and authorized operations on existing Sheet content retain their behavior.
- Use the existing fixed 44 px help slot and DetailsPopover for readable keyboard/touch errors. New insertion requires a connection; newly inserted bytes in a downloaded Sheet remain available after offline reload.

No new package, proprietary package, image store, synchronization model or SDK patch.

title: 🌷 SPN-128 Reinstall the preserved original after an interrupted restore
body:
## Problem and result

An interrupted restore can leave the workspace closed even though its newest original content is preserved. This PR adds the supported `recover-original --operation UUID` supervisor command to authenticate that original, reconcile access and negative restore evidence, and open it as a new original generation. It preserves work saved after the last backup and reports the existing **Original content was recovered** outcome/banner.

## Implementation and safety

- Fresh, bounded cold-host Operator authority comes from the existing private service-UID control socket. The expired application authorization, original restore intent and every interrupted cold attempt remain immutable history.
- Recovery verifies the frozen source against the independent pre-shutdown fingerprint, retains the closed live tuple as private raw evidence, and reuses rollback reconciliation, the prepared-original installer and the original private-trial commitment protocol.
- Partial replacement bytes are never opened as SQLite. Missing, changed, ambiguous, wrong-target or wrong-policy evidence leaves the workspace closed.
- A committed backup is never replaced. A committed original can reopen its current live generation without reinstalling older bytes; replay cannot take over a different maintenance operation.
- The maintained backup and maintenance runbooks describe the supported command and limits. SPN-124's lifetime extension and SPN-125's evidence pruning remain separate.

## Scope and current checkpoint
